ns2:section.sectionText: Register in this one CRN for lecture and lab section. This course covers introductory zoological concepts of animal anatomy, physiology, behavior, genetics and evolution. In this lab section we will explore concepts of animal anatomy, physiology, behavior, genetics and evolution, and integrate the lab topic with each weeks' lecture material, emphasizing current research and relevant health issues. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
